card.title: Apologize for the Lie
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that the concealment or misdirection mattered, even if the underlying choice was defensible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm not asking you to apologise for cancelling. Apologise for not telling me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't want to upset you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So you let me arrive with a cake instead.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry the party didn't happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Try the part where I didn't know.

mechanism: A insists the apology name withheld information rather than substitute regret for the cancelled event.
confusable: Unlike demanding the underlying choice be reversed, A distinguishes cancellation from letting A arrive unaware.
comparison: The party scene corrects an evasive apology; the rescue-dog scene accepts compensation while demanding informed consent.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
